runtimes.label: llama.cpp — Windows Hexagon QNN (NPU)
runtimes.notes: VERIFIED FAILING 2026-11-08: ggml-hex 'failed to open session 0: error 0x80000406' -> GGML_ASSERT(device) rc=9. Build predates the working stack (GenieX v0.10.0 / QAIRT 2.50 runs HTP0 fine) — needs a rebuild against QAIRT 2.50 + current skels/certs. The log endpoint is how we know this in one click.

runtimes.label: GenieX serve — default compute
runtimes.notes: GenieX CLI v0.5.0 OpenAI-compatible server. Model chosen per request (model id from ~/.cache/geniex). Compute default unless -c passed.

runtimes.label: GenieX serve — compute NPU
runtimes.notes: v0.5.0 -c npu died on GGML_ASSERT(device) in `infer` in August — serve may behave differently; start and read the log to learn the truth. The v0.10.0 bench proves HTP works (HTP0).
